title: Utilization of Machine Learning-Based Computer Vision and Voice Analysis to Derive Digital Biomarkers of Cognitive Functioning in Trauma Survivors.
summary: The feasibility study analyzed 81 trauma survivors and reports prediction of cognitive-functioning measures from video and speech features. This is a small, unreplicated cohort result; independent validation and clinical utility are not established.
ai_technology: Computer-vision and voice features were used in machine-learning models to predict cognitive-test domains in trauma survivors.
organization: Vagelos School of Physicians and Surgeons, Columbia University Medical Center; New York University School of Medicine
